svg.title: Index calculation
svg.desc: GPU activities [1-45]. Solid bars: logical execution/access scopes; hollow dashed bars: unconsumed requests. Blue H2D, red D2H/host sync, purple AllToAll, amber request wait, green stream dependency. forward(features) ShardedModule creates EC context features.permute(_features_order) align input key order with sharding plan permute_2D_sparse_data permute lengths and values activities [1-7] permute lengths/data + CUB scans jagged_unique_indices unique is local and happens before row bucketize; optional use_index_dedup activities [8-45] offset cumsum -> linearize -> sort/unique -> delinearize save ctx.reverse_indices original position -> local unique position
svg.text: Activation / access scope; nested bars = self-calls
Click messages or file:line links to open TorchRec ↗
Example activity IDs and sizes vary by execution; source links identify TorchRec callsites for backend work.

g.text: align input key order with sharding plan
unique is local and happens before row bucketize; optional

svg.text: reverse_indices is not used yet; it is consumed only after output AllToAll and unbucketization.
Activities [8-10] build input offsets; the sort/scan kernels that follow are implementation children of fbgemm.jagged_unique_indices.
Activity IDs, sizes, kernel names and optimizer details illustrate one execution configuration; they are not fixed for every run.
